verdict.rationale: An in-engine AI assistant is a fair question for a game engine, but the evidence shows no official Bevy AI assistant for generating scripts, answering API questions, or scaffolding scenes. The only AI-adjacent items are a probe noting there is no llms.txt and no official MCP, plus third-party community tooling, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an official AI assistant inside the engine helps with engine tasks — generating scripts, answering API questions, scaffolding scenes or assets
